quarterly_data.quarter: Jabil press release: Adani Enterprises, Jabil Sign MoU for 50:50 Data Center (10-13-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Jabil and Adani Enterprises signed a non-binding Memorandum of Understanding setting out the framework for a proposed 50:50 joint venture to manufacture and assemble AI racks, servers, storage and networking equipment in India, plus power distribution units, liquid-cooling systems and transformers, with installation and commissioning services. The venture is expected to have multi-gigawatt AI rack manufacturing capacity and would serve domestic demand and exports; it remains subject to definitive agreements and approvals (it follows the June 2026 alliance announcement). The companies estimate the global market opportunity at more than $3 trillion over the next seven years. CEO Mike Dastoor: the platform can 'bring our rack-level data center solutions to more hyperscalers in India and around the world.'
quarterly_data.figure: proposed 50:50 joint venture; multi-gigawatt AI rack manufacturing capacity
